title: Ores With Borders
description: This texture pack adds borders to ores.
body:
Ores With Borders makes ores have borders. Ores With Borders is just a simple resource pack that only does what the name suggests. It includes all of the ores that exist in the game, including nether ores. If you want a preview of what the ores look like, then here they are:


<details>
<summary>Ores:</summary>

![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3f17d90064a8d1caacc421c31965eeb7653a277.png)

</details>

# How to install
- Hold [Win + r] and then put in: **%appdata%\.minecraft\resourcepacks**
- Drag **Ores With Borders** into the folder
- Close your file explorer
- Launch MC (1.19-26.1)
- Click options, then resource packs
- Then enable Ores With Borders

### **Note: It might say incompatible (Made for an older version), but it still works the same as it would on 1.21 or 1.20**
